content.text:
The bug was introduced the same day the file was created, in commit b4639602a22a16c7bd671ffd1cc2d1dafabd501d, which added `CustomPieChart.java` with the `performHighlight` method body missing its method signature — a stray code block directly inside the anonymous `PieRadarChartTouchListener` class, rather than overriding `performHighlight(Highlight h, MotionEvent e)`. This meant the touch listener never actually overrode the highlight behavior (and likely wouldn't even compile, or at best was dead/no-op code), defeating the stated purpose "Override to disable unhighlight function." The fix commit (dc4ddf0) simply added the missing `protected void performHighlight(Highlight h, MotionEvent e) {` method declaration around that exact same block of logic, confirming this was the missing piece from the original commit.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: b4639602a22a16c7bd671ffd1cc2d1dafabd501d

## Reasoning
(1) I traced the file history of `CustomPieChart.java` (the only file touched by the fix) using `git log --follow` and found it was created in exactly one prior commit, b463960, right before the fix commit dc4ddf0 (same author, same day). I then diffed the fix commit against its parent to see the pre-fix state, and compared that to the commit that originally added the file.

(2) The introducing commit added an anonymous subclass of `PieRadarChartTouchListener` containing a bare code block (`if (h != null && !h.equalTo(mLastHighlighted)) {...}`) that was not wrapped in any method override. This block was clearly intended to override `performHighlight(Highlight h, MotionEvent e)` (per the class javadoc "Override to disable unhighlight function"), but the method signature was omitted, so the override never took effect.

(3) Evidence: the fix commit's diff does nothing but wrap that identical code block in `protected void performHighlight(Highlight h, MotionEvent e) {` and removes now-unused imports (`View`, `ChartTouchListener`, `OnChartGestureListener`) that were presumably leftovers from in-progress editing. The file was net-new in b463960 with the malformed block already present — there are no intermediate commits between creation and the fix — so b463960 is the sole commit that introduced the defect.
